questions.title: IMF raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong domestic demand
questions.subject: economy
questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the IMF's October World Economic Outlook projections:
items: India's projected economic growth for 2026-27 was revised upward to 7%.
Global economic growth is projected to contract below 2% in 2026.

questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.why: The IMF revised India's FY27 growth to 7% and noted that 32 economies account for 95% of global expansion, while global growth is projected at 3.1% in 2026, not contracting below 2%.

questions.title: IMF raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong domestic demand
questions.subject: economy
questions.q: According to the IMF, which primary domestic factor supported the upward revision of India's FY27 growth forecast?
options: A surge in merchandise exports to advanced economies
Resilient domestic demand and robust services activity
Sharp decline in global imported crude oil prices
Massive agricultural output expansion following favorable monsoons
questions.why: The IMF attributed the upgrade to stronger economic momentum supported by resilient domestic demand and a robust services sector.
